header.running_head: Enduring Hunger when Inviting People Towards Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ

blocks.text: bread, said, "O Abu Ayyoob! Send this to Faatima (RA) because she has not had anything like it for many days." Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) took it to Hadhrat Faatima (RA).

After they had all eaten to their fill, Rasulullaah ﷺ's eyes filled with tears as he said, "Bread, meat, ripe dates, juicy dates and dry dates. I swear by the Being Who controls my life! These are the bounties about which you will be questioned on the Day of Qiyaamah." Noticing that this statement had a profound effect on his companions, Rasulullaah ﷺ added, "When you receive something like this and start eating, recite - 'In the name of Allaah' and once you have eaten to your fill, recite:

blocks.arabic_text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ هُوَ أَشْبَعَنَا وَأَنْعَمَ عَلَيْنَا فَأَفْضَلَ
blocks.text: 'All praise is due to Allaah Who has filled our bellies, showered His bounties on us and granted us plenty.'
Rasulullaah ﷺ further told them that reciting this du'aa shall compensate for the food (and one will not be questioned about it on the Day of Qiyaamah).

When they got up to leave, Rasulullaah ﷺ told Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) to see him the following day because whenever someone did him a good turn, he liked to repay it. However, Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) did not hear what Rasulullaah ﷺ said so Hadhrat Umar (RA) told him, "Rasulullaah ﷺ commands you to see him tomorrow." When Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) met Rasulullaah ﷺ the following day, Rasulullaah ﷺ gave him a slave woman he possessed and said, "O Abu Ayyoob! I request you to treat her well because we have only seen good in her since she has been with us." After leaving Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) said to himself, "I see no better way of complying with the request of Rasulullaah ﷺ other than setting her free." He therefore set her free.[^1]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports that he once heard Hadhrat Umar (RA) narrate that Rasulullaah ﷺ left home one afternoon and found Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) in the Masjid. "What brings you here at this hour?" asked Rasulullaah ﷺ. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "The same thing that brought you here, O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" When Hadhrat Umar (RA) arrived there, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked, "What brings you here at this hour?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied, "The same thing that brought the two of you here." Rasulullaah ﷺ then started talking to them. He then said, "Do you two have the strength to walk to an orchard where we shall find, food, drink and shade?" Rasulullaah ﷺ then took them to the house of Hadhrat Abul Haytham bin Tayyihaan (RA) who was from the Ansaar. A lengthy Hadith follows.[^2] Imaam Mundhiri[^3] says that this incident probably occurred once with Hadhrat Abu Ayyoob (RA) and once with Hadhrat Abul Haytham (RA).
Tabraani and Ibn Hibbaan as quoted in Targheeb wat Tarheeb (Vol.3 Pg.431).
Bazzaar, Abu Ya'la, Uqayli, Ibn Mardaway, Bayhaqi and Sa'eed bin Mansoor as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.4 Pg.40). Muslim and Maalik have also narrated it briefly.
